<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Network issues can significantly impact productivity and user experience and often present as <strong>no connectivity</strong>, <strong>slow performance</strong>, <strong>intermittent dropouts</strong>, or <strong>limited network access</strong>. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Wired network troubleshooting should always begin by verifying <strong>physical layer components</strong>—inspect Ethernet cables for damage, confirm they are rated properly (Cat5e, Cat6, etc.), and ensure that connectors are fully seated. Examine <strong>link lights</strong> on both the network card and switch to verify physical connectivity. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jVMZbVFklM\u0026amp;pp=ygUONS43IGNvbXB0aWEgYSs%3D","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3jVMZbVFklM&amp;pp=ygUONS43IGNvbXB0aWEgYSs%3D
</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>If the link lights are off or amber instead of green, the problem may be a bad port, faulty cable, or power issue with the switch or router. Running commands like <code>ipconfig</code> (Windows) or <code>ifconfig</code> / <code>ip addr</code> (Linux) helps confirm whether the device has received a valid IP address and gateway from the <strong>DHCP server</strong>. Incorrect IP configuration, such as an APIPA (169.254.x.x) address, typically indicates a DHCP failure or misconfigured static IP.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pwbjv-oOKZA\u0026amp;pp=ygUONS43IGNvbXB0aWEgYSs%3D","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->

</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Wireless networks add another layer of complexity due to <strong>radio frequency (RF)</strong> behavior. Weak or unstable signals may be caused by distance, walls, or interference from appliances like microwaves and cordless phones. Technicians should perform a <strong>site survey</strong> or use a Wi-Fi analyzer to identify coverage holes and overlapping channels. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xw-vU98bPCw\u0026amp;t=11s\u0026amp;","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xw-vU98bPCw&amp;t=11s&amp;
</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>In dense environments, adjusting the wireless access point's channel settings and output power can reduce interference and improve signal quality. <strong>SSID misconfiguration</strong>, incorrect encryption methods (WPA3 vs. WPA2), or authentication errors can also cause users to be unable to connect. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Y3v6Z85O-4\u0026amp;","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6Y3v6Z85O-4&amp;
</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Verifying and updating router firmware helps ensure that the wireless infrastructure is functioning correctly, especially when supporting newer client devices.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Advanced network troubleshooting involves examining <strong>switching</strong> and <strong>routing</strong> configurations. For example, VLAN misconfigurations may cause devices to appear connected physically but not communicate with other network segments. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EfEA_5tDH8A\u0026amp;","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EfEA_5tDH8A&amp;
</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>On wireless networks using multiple access points, devices may suffer from <strong>roaming issues</strong> where clients fail to properly transition between APs, causing intermittent disconnections. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:embed {"url":"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wHo-IpFblio\u0026amp;pp=ygUid2lyZWQgbmV0d29yayBwcm9ibGVtcyB2cyB3aXJlbGVzcw%3D%3D","type":"video","providerNameSlug":"youtube","responsive":true,"className":"wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"} -->
<figure class="wp-block-embed is-type-video is-provider-youtube wp-block-embed-youtube wp-embed-aspect-16-9 wp-has-aspect-ratio"><div class="wp-block-embed__wrapper">
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wHo-IpFblio&amp;pp=ygUid2lyZWQgbmV0d29yayBwcm9ibGVtcyB2cyB3aXJlbGVzcw%3D%3D
</div></figure>
<!-- /wp:embed -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Performance issues can also stem from <strong>bandwidth saturation</strong>, where too many users or applications are consuming network resources, requiring QoS (Quality of Service) or bandwidth management adjustments. Additionally, <strong>security appliances</strong> like firewalls and content filters may block or limit access depending on rules or misconfigurations. </p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->

<!-- wp:paragraph {"className":""} -->
<p>Comprehensive troubleshooting includes verifying network topology, reviewing logs, and performing systematic isolation to narrow down the source of the problem.</p>
<!-- /wp:paragraph -->
